description.sl: Kovač Toni je mojster in uči pomočnika v svoji delavnici: obrt in obrtniki, mojstrski izpit, mizarji in mizarstvo, ključavničar, krojač in čevljar, steklar, pleskar in pečar, strugar in rezbar, oblanje, spajkanje in varjenje, material, ročno delo in predračun. Avstrijsko: der Tischler, der Hafner, der Anstreicher.
description.en: Toni the smith is a master and trains his journeyman in his workshop: crafts and tradesmen, the master's exam, joiners and the joinery, the metalworker, the tailor and the cobbler, the glazier, the house painter and the stove fitter, the wood turner and the woodcarver, planing, soldering and welding, materials, handmade work and the quote. Austrian: der Tischler, der Hafner, der Anstreicher.
description.it: Il fabbro Toni è maestro artigiano e forma il suo lavorante in officina: l'artigianato e gli artigiani, l'esame di maestro, falegnami e falegnameria, il fabbro meccanico, il sarto e il calzolaio, il vetraio, l'imbianchino e lo stufaio, il tornitore e l'intagliatore, piallare, saldare, i materiali, il lavoro a mano e il preventivo. In austriaco: der Tischler, der Hafner, der Anstreicher.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_de: Handwerk hat goldenen Boden, sagt Toni.
words.example_sl: Obrt ima zlato dno, pravi Toni.
words.example_en: A trade in hand finds gold in every land, says Toni.
words.example_it: Impara l'arte e mettila da parte, dice Toni.
words.note: A proverb: a craft stands on a golden floor.
words.note_it: Un proverbio: l'artigianato ha un pavimento d'oro.

words.example_de: Einen guten Handwerker zu finden, ist heute schwer.
words.example_sl: Dobrega obrtnika je danes težko najti.
words.example_en: It's hard to find a good tradesman these days.
words.example_it: Oggi è difficile trovare un buon artigiano.

words.example_de: Toni ist Meister, sein Geselle lernt noch.
words.example_sl: Toni je mojster, njegov pomočnik se še uči.
words.example_en: Toni is a master; his journeyman is still learning.
words.example_it: Toni è maestro artigiano, il suo lavorante sta ancora imparando.
words.note: A woman: die Meisterin. Also a champion.
words.note_it: Una donna: die Meisterin. Anche un campione.

words.example_de: Nach der Meisterprüfung darf Toni Lehrlinge ausbilden.
words.example_sl: Po mojstrskem izpitu sme Toni izobraževati vajence.
words.example_en: After his master's exam Toni may train apprentices.
words.example_it: Dopo l'esame di maestro Toni può formare apprendisti.

words.example_de: Der Geselle arbeitet seit fünf Jahren in Tonis Schmiede.
words.example_sl: Pomočnik že pet let dela v Tonijevi kovačnici.
words.example_en: The journeyman has worked in Toni's forge for five years.
words.example_it: Il lavorante lavora nella fucina di Toni da cinque anni.
words.note: Weak noun: den Gesellen; a woman: die Gesellin.
words.note_sl: Šibki samostalnik: den Gesellen; ženska: die Gesellin.
words.note_it: Sostantivo debole: den Gesellen; una donna: die Gesellin.

words.example_de: In der Werkstatt riecht es nach Eisen und Holz.
words.example_sl: V delavnici diši po železu in lesu.
words.example_en: The workshop smells of iron and wood.
words.example_it: In officina c'è odore di ferro e legno.

words.example_de: Der Tischler macht Kathi einen neuen Tisch für die Gaststube.
words.example_sl: Mizar Kathi naredi novo mizo za gostilniško sobo.
words.example_en: The joiner is making Kathi a new table for the bar room.
words.example_it: Il falegname fa a Kathi un tavolo nuovo per la sala.
words.note: Austrian and northern German; in south-west Germany der Schreiner.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko in severnonemško; na jugozahodu Nemčije der Schreiner.
words.note_it: Austriaco e tedesco del nord; nel sud-ovest della Germania der Schreiner.

words.example_de: In der Tischlerei am Ortsrand arbeiten vier Leute.
words.example_sl: V mizarstvu na robu vasi delajo štirje ljudje.
words.example_en: Four people work in the joinery on the edge of the village.
words.example_it: Nella falegnameria ai margini del paese lavorano quattro persone.

words.example_de: Der Schlosser repariert das Gitter vor dem Kellerfenster.
words.example_sl: Ključavničar popravi mrežo pred kletnim oknom.
words.example_en: The metalworker repairs the grille in front of the cellar window.
words.example_it: Il fabbro ripara la grata davanti alla finestra della cantina.

words.example_de: Die Schneiderin näht Lena ein neues Dirndl.
words.example_sl: Šivilja Leni sešije nov dirndl.
words.example_en: The dressmaker is making Lena a new dirndl.
words.example_it: La sarta cuce a Lena un nuovo dirndl.

words.example_de: Die Bergschuhe bringt Florian jedes Jahr zum Schuster.
words.example_sl: Planinske čevlje Florian vsako leto nese k čevljarju.
words.example_en: Every year Florian takes his mountain boots to the cobbler.
words.example_it: Ogni anno Florian porta gli scarponi dal calzolaio.

words.example_de: Nach Maxis Elfmeter muss der Glaser kommen.
words.example_sl: Po Maxijevi enajstmetrovki mora priti steklar.
words.example_en: After Maxi's penalty the glazier has to come.
words.example_it: Dopo il rigore di Maxi deve venire il vetraio.

words.example_de: Der Anstreicher streicht die Fassade vom Gasthaus gelb.
words.example_sl: Pleskar fasado gostilne prebarva rumeno.
words.example_en: The house painter is painting the front of the inn yellow.
words.example_it: L'imbianchino dipinge di giallo la facciata della trattoria.
words.note: Austrian, often der Maler und Anstreicher.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko, pogosto der Maler und Anstreicher.
words.note_it: Austriaco, spesso der Maler und Anstreicher.

words.example_de: Der Hafner setzt einen neuen Kachelofen in die Stube von Resi.
words.example_sl: Pečar postavi novo krušno peč v Resino izbo.
words.example_en: The stove fitter is building a new tiled stove in Resi's parlour.
words.example_it: Lo stufaio monta una nuova stufa di maiolica nella stube di Resi.
words.note: Austrian and southern German; elsewhere der Ofensetzer.
words.note_sl: Avstrijsko in južnonemško; drugod der Ofensetzer.
words.note_it: Austriaco e tedesco del sud; altrove der Ofensetzer.

words.example_de: Der Drechsler macht aus Ahorn Schüsseln und Löffel.
words.example_sl: Strugar iz javorja izdeluje sklede in žlice.
words.example_en: The wood turner makes bowls and spoons out of maple.
words.example_it: Il tornitore fa ciotole e cucchiai di acero.

words.example_de: Am Abend schnitzt Sepp Krampusmasken.
words.example_sl: Zvečer Sepp rezlja maske krampusov.
words.example_en: In the evenings Sepp carves Krampus masks.
words.example_it: La sera Sepp intaglia maschere di Krampus.

words.example_de: Der Schnitzer aus dem Lesachtal verkauft Krippenfiguren.
words.example_sl: Rezbar iz Lesne doline prodaja jaslične figure.
words.example_en: The woodcarver from the Lesachtal sells nativity figures.
words.example_it: L'intagliatore della Lesachtal vende statuine del presepe.
words.note: Also a blunder: ein grober Schnitzer.
words.note_sl: Tudi huda napaka: ein grober Schnitzer.
words.note_it: Anche uno sbaglio: ein grober Schnitzer.

words.example_de: Toni hobelt das Brett, bis es ganz glatt ist.
words.example_sl: Toni oblanja desko, dokler ni čisto gladka.
words.example_en: Toni planes the board until it's perfectly smooth.
words.example_it: Toni pialla l'asse finché non è liscissima.

words.example_de: Den alten Hobel hat Toni von seinem Großvater.
words.example_sl: Stari oblič je Toni dobil od deda.
words.example_en: Toni's old plane came from his grandfather.
words.example_it: La vecchia pialla Toni l'ha avuta dal nonno.

words.example_de: Mit dem Lötkolben lötet Toni das Kabel.
words.example_sl: S spajkalnikom Toni prispajka kabel.
words.example_en: Toni solders the cable with the soldering iron.
words.example_it: Con il saldatore Toni salda il cavo.

words.example_de: Toni schweißt das kaputte Gitter wieder zusammen.
words.example_sl: Toni pokvarjeno mrežo spet zvari.
words.example_en: Toni welds the broken grille back together.
words.example_it: Toni salda di nuovo la grata rotta.

words.example_de: Für den Tisch verwendet Toni nur Material aus dem eigenen Wald.
words.example_sl: Za mizo Toni uporablja le material iz lastnega gozda.
words.example_en: For the table Toni uses only material from his own forest.
words.example_it: Per il tavolo Toni usa solo materiale del suo bosco.

words.example_de: Jeder Rechen von Toni ist Handarbeit.
words.example_sl: Vsake grablje, ki jih naredi Toni, so ročno delo.
words.example_en: Every rake of Toni's is handmade.
words.example_it: Ogni rastrello di Toni è fatto a mano.

words.example_de: Vor der Arbeit macht Toni immer einen Kostenvoranschlag.
words.example_sl: Pred delom Toni vedno naredi predračun.
words.example_en: Before starting Toni always gives a quote.
words.example_it: Prima del lavoro Toni fa sempre un preventivo.
